start.welcome: Hi! I'm Volty. I tell you when the power goes out and comes back, and show your battery level.
start.ready: Volty is ready. Use the buttons below.
connect.choose_region: Which LuxPower server do you use? Its address is shown in your browser on the monitoring site.
connect.ask_login:
Send your LuxPower login.

I delete your login and password messages right after reading them and store them encrypted. They still pass through Telegram like any other message.
connect.bad_credentials: ❌ LuxPower rejected this login or password.
connect.unavailable: ⚠️ LuxPower isn't responding. Try again later.
connect.no_inverters: This LuxPower account has no inverters.
connect.delete_failed: ⚠️ I couldn't delete your message. Please delete it yourself.
battery.offline: 📡 {name} is offline in the LuxPower cloud, so there is no fresh data.
battery.unavailable: ⚠️ LuxPower isn't responding. Try again in a minute.
grid.off_grid: 🔌 Grid: no power, running on batteries
alert.off_grid:
🔌 Power is out at {name}. Running on batteries.
🔋 {soc}% · {voltage} V
alert.on_grid_charging:
💡 Power is back at {name}. Batteries are charging.
🔋 {soc}% · {voltage} V
error.reauth: 🔑 LuxPower rejected the saved password. Connect the inverter again to resume monitoring.
notifications.title: I tell you when the power goes out and when it comes back. Tap a button to choose where alerts go.
settings.title: Settings
disconnect.choose: Which account do you want to disconnect?
disconnect.confirm: Disconnect this account? I will delete its saved login, password, and inverters.
disconnect.done: Account disconnected, and its data is deleted.
group.linked: ✅ Power alerts for {name} will now come to this group.
group.cannot_post: ⚠️ I can't post in “{title}”. Allow the bot to send messages there and add it again.
rename.choose: Which inverter do you want to rename?
rename.ask: What should I call {name}? For example, Home or Cottage.
rename.invalid: The name must be 1 to {limit} characters long. Try again.
